conventions.commits: Conventional commits (type(scope): subject, e.g. 'feat(core): add Swift language support with tree-sitter-swift handler (#1742)'), each commit body ends with 'Signed-off-by: Hugues Clouatre <...>' (DCO). Issue also requires GPG-signed commits. External PRs for #1864 are not accepted (maintainers implement in-house).
conventions.testing: Inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests in each languages/<lang>.rs parsing with tree_sitter::Parser and running Query::new against ELEMENT_QUERY/IMPORT_QUERY, or SemanticExtractor::extract_def_use_for_file for defuse. Language-table tests live in languages/mod.rs and lang.rs. Integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/*.rs use common::call_tool_raw and tempfile::NamedTempFile::with_suffix_in(".php", cwd).
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --locked --profile ci -- -D warnings -W clippy::cognitive_complexity (ci.yml); cargo deny check advisories licenses bans (ci.yml line 211); workspace lints deny unwrap_used, expect_used, undocumented_unsafe_blocks; REUSE compliance (REUSE.toml). AGENTS.md says do not add deps without justification.
conventions.error_handling: Handlers return Option<String> / Vec<String> and never panic; parser returns ParserError (UnsupportedLanguage, QueryError, ParseError, Timeout) via thiserror; get_compiled_queries maps query compile failures to UnsupportedLanguage after logging via tracing::error. Non-test code avoids unwrap/expect; Java handler uses u32::try_from(i).unwrap_or(u32::MAX) and bounds-checked source slicing.

patterns: Registry pattern: one pub mod per language in languages/mod.rs; get_language_info() returns a LanguageInfo struct literal per language; get_ts_language() maps the name to a tree_sitter::Language.
Extension map pattern: lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP is a const slice of (ext, lang) tuples; language_for_extension() is a case-insensitive lookup; supported_languages() is a separate hand-written list.

Query constants as pub const &str raw strings (r"...") with capture names contracted to parser_elements.rs (function, class, func_name, method_name, class_name, call, import_path, type_ref, write.*, read.*, writeread.*).
Element extraction: @function on the whole definition node plus @func_name or @method_name; @class on the whole type node plus @class_name. Java, CSS and Kotlin use this shape.

Inheritance: an ExtractInheritanceHandler fn(&Node,&str)->Vec<String> stored as an Option in LanguageInfo; Java walks child_by_field_name('superclass') and 'interfaces'; Swift walks named children; PHP has no such fields and must iterate children by kind.

Defuse: DEFUSE_QUERY uses write.* / read.* / writeread.* capture prefixes; the dedup in extract_def_use skips a read capture whose start_byte matches a write capture, so a catch-all read pattern is safe.
Imports: IMPORT_QUERY captures the whole declaration as @import_path; extract_imports_from_node has a fallback that stores the full statement text as the module.
Optional handlers: languages without a feature set None (Fortran defuse_query None; markdown and yaml have no references or imports); the Option type means DEFUSE_QUERY is not compile-required.
Test-table pattern: languages/mod.rs test_get_language_info_covers_remaining_registered_languages checks name, reference_query.is_some(), import_query.is_some() for a list of languages.

constraints: External PRs for #1864 are not accepted; maintainers are implementing in-house (issue Note on Process). Scout output is for internal planning only.

Scope limit from the issue: no extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type; no trait use resolution, property/constant extraction, attributes, namespace alias import; no .phtml/.inc/.module/.php5 extensions; no tool handler or schema changes.
The grammar crate exports two languages: LANGUAGE_PHP (expects <?php, handles inline HTML) and LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY. The issue's HTML-template acceptance criterion requires LANGUAGE_PHP.
Cargo.lock entries must be at least 7 days old (AGENTS.md). tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 was published 2026-11-19, about 9 days before the run date; 0.25.0 was 2026-09-24.

The grammar crate depends on tree-sitter-language 0.1 (already in Cargo.lock as 0.1.9) and has dev-dep tree-sitter 0.27; the workspace pins tree-sitter 0.27.1, so the grammar should unify without a second tree-sitter.
cargo deny check must pass; tree-sitter-php is MIT, which is in deny.toml's allow list.
Workspace lint policy: unwrap_used and expect_used are deny (test code exempt via cfg_attr); unsafe needs a SAFETY comment.
DEFUSE_QUERY is an Option in LanguageInfo and only the test-only extract_def_use_for_file consumes it. It is required by the issue's scope and by parity with java/swift, not by the type system.

Each language must be added to both get_language_info() and get_ts_language(); missing either breaks parsing (resolve_and_parse uses get_language_info; extract_def_use_for_file uses get_ts_language path at parser.rs:631).
test_coverage: languages/mod.rs has test_get_language_info_known, _unknown, _covers_remaining_registered_languages (table of tsx/fortran/markdown/css/yaml with reference and import expectations); lang.rs has happy-path and edge-case extension tests and the ECMAScript schema-pattern test over all EXTENSION_MAP entries (gated on the schemars feature). Each handler (css.rs, java.rs, swift.rs, etc.) has inline tests that parse a snippet and check queries. Defuse has tests in parser.rs (rust) and in java.rs and csharp.rs. Integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests cover unsupported-extension fallback and analyze_file/analyze_module shapes; no PHP coverage exists anywhere (rg php found nothing outside docs).

approaches.name: A: Java-shaped handler with field-less inheritance walk (recommended)
approaches.description: Create languages/php.rs modeled on java.rs: ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class/interface/trait/enum declarations), CALL_QUERY (function_call_expression, member_call_expression, nullsafe, scoped_call_expression), REFERENCE_QUERY (named_type), IMPORT_QUERY (namespace_use_declaration), DEFUSE_QUERY (assignment, augmented, update, static var, simple_parameter, variable_name reads), plus extract_inheritance that iterates children by kind (base_clause -> extends, class_interface_clause -> implements). Wire into lang.rs (EXTENSION_MAP, supported_languages), mod.rs (pub mod, get_language_info, get_ts_language), Cargo.toml workspace and core, README, lib.rs docs, and tests.
pros: Matches the issue's five-constant contract and its named templates
Every query verified to compile and match against tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 in a scratch crate
Inheritance walk verified on class/interface/enum samples
No extra handler helpers, so it stays inside the issue's Not-in-Scope list
cons: PHP has no field names for base_clause and class_interface_clause, so the walk is by kind (slightly less robust to grammar changes)
DEFUSE_QUERY has no production consumer; it only serves tests and parity
Catch-all read pattern produces many read sites in large files (same trade-off as java.rs)

approaches.name: B: Minimal handler with no DEFUSE_QUERY and no extract_inheritance
approaches.description: Ship ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY and IMPORT_QUERY only, with defuse_query: None and extract_inheritance: None in mod.rs.
pros: Option fields allow None (fortran and markdown already do this)
cons: Fails the issue's acceptance criteria: extends/implements must return the listed strings and DEFUSE_QUERY is in the five-constant scope
Loses inheritance output the issue asks for

approaches.name: C: Use the grammar's own tags.scm plus a generic element query
approaches.description: Adapt the grammar's queries/tags.scm (definition.class, definition.interface, definition.function, reference.call, reference.implementation) into ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY, and add the inheritance handler from A.
pros: Captures already validated upstream by the grammar maintainers
Covers property_declaration fields for a later step
cons: tags.scm uses definition./reference. capture names that parser_elements does not consume; the names must be renamed to function, class, func_name, class_name, call
Adds property and implementation references that are out of scope
Upstream tags.scm does not cover enum or trait as a separate kind

recommendation: Approach A. It meets every acceptance criterion in the issue, reuses the java.rs shape the issue names, and every query was checked against the grammar. DEFUSE_QUERY is included because the issue requires it and the Java handler and tests follow the same pattern; it is not compile-required (Option<&str>) and has no production caller, so treat it as parity rather than a runtime need. Use LANGUAGE_PHP (not PHP_ONLY) so the mixed HTML case parses with zero ERROR nodes.

inheritance_walk_citation: Grammar source: php/grammar.js -> common/define-grammar.js, rules class_declaration, base_clause, class_interface_clause, interface_declaration, enum_declaration (read via gh api). class_declaration: seq(optional(field('attributes', attribute_list)), repeat(_modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', reserved('classes', name)), optional(base_clause), optional(class_interface_clause), field('body', declaration_list)). base_clause: seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1(_name)). class_interface_clause: seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1(_name)). _name: choice(alias(keyword('static'), name), reserved('classes', name), qualified_name, relative_name). Walk: from class_declaration node, take child_by_field_name('name') for the class name (field name, a 'name' node); base_clause and class_interface_clause are NOT fields, so iterate named children and match kind 'base_clause' (each named child of kind name, qualified_name or relative_name becomes 'extends X') and kind 'class_interface_clause' (each becomes 'implements X'). The field-name list in php/src/node-types.json for class_declaration is only attributes, body, name; base_clause and class_interface_clause appear only as children. Verified in a scratch run: class Dog extends Bar implements A, B yields ["extends Bar", "implements A", "implements B"]; class Plain {} yields []; interface I extends X, Y yields ["extends X", "extends Y"] (interface uses base_clause); enum E: string implements A yields ["implements A"] (enum uses class_interface_clause).
